reviews.title: Highway Robbery???
reviews.text:
I've been a long time supporter of this app. Purchased possibly ovr a decade ago and enjoyed using it up to this point... where my enjoyment ends is upon realising they have removed features that were already built into the paid version and putting them behind a paywall add-on.

The description stating you can view satallites was accurate before but no longer. That is now an additional payment that is not included with the app. Misleading and theft when many of us already paid for that feature.

Save your money and find an online starchart

reviews.title: Doesn’t work with phone case
reviews.text: Please provide a fix to the issue with the app not working when the phone has a case.  I removed the case and the app worked fine. I placed the phone back in the case and the app will not work. It remains stuck with a North geo point in the middle and will not function.  People shouldn’t have to remove their case to utilize an app. Others have posted the issue here for weeks. It’s about time to resolve it.

reviews.title: Never should have purchased - Satellite database bug
reviews.text:
I loved the SkyView Lite app. I have been using it for many years, and I decided that I should purchase the full product to show my appreciation. After installation, all satellite data is gone - zero, none. It used to show the ISS. I futzed around. There is no way to restore purchases - only an option to purchase the SkyView Satellite Guide. Ok, I'll pay a little more to get the additional satellite data. However, satellites still do not show int he SkyView app. Hence my 1 star rating. I will leave it there until the publisher provides a solution.
--timdier
